relations.evidence: User executing the CREATE INDEX statement must have the Query Manage Index privilege granted on the keyspace.

relations.subject: n1ql:create-index
relations.evidence: In Couchbase Server 7.0 and later, CREATE INDEX allows you to make multiple concurrent index creation requests.

relations.subject: n1ql:create-index
relations.evidence: In Couchbase Server 6.5 and later, the index type for a secondary index must be Global Secondary Index (GSI).

relations.subject: n1ql:with-num_replica
relations.evidence: [ENTERPRISE EDITION] ... you can specify multiple nodes to distribute replicas of an index.

relations.subject: n1ql:with-nodes
relations.evidence: [COMMUNITY EDITION] a single secondary index of type GSI can be placed on a single node... The nodes property enables you to specify the node.
